hk_locality_rule._doc: On a Hong Kong site, pricing and locality that are not Hong Kong are REPLACED by 'contact us for information', not footnoted. Applies to RMB fee schedules, national sitting calendars, mainland city allocation rules and mainland venue lists.
hk_locality_rule.keep: Mainland places in BIOGRAPHY (an expert's university) and in NEWS reports of past events are factual history and stay.
